continuation.description:
If the success response contains a continuation token, the list contains more items
you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more items
from the list, for example `?continuation={continuation}`.

To retrieve all items, you might need to make multiple requests.

CommentContent.description: The content of a comment thread or reply.

plaintext.description:
The content in plaintext.
Any user mention tags are shown in the format `[user_id:team_id]`.

markdown.description:
The content in markdown.
Any user mention tags are shown in the format `[user_id:team_id]`

Reply.description:
A reply to a thread.

The `author` of the reply might be missing if that user account no longer exists.

design_id.description: The ID of the design that the thread for this reply is attached to.

thread_id.description: The ID of the thread this reply is in.

mentions.description: The Canva users mentioned in the comment thread or reply.

created_at.description:
When the reply was created, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the reply was last updated, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

TeamUser.description: Metadata for the user, consisting of the User ID, Team ID, and display name.

team_id.description: The ID of the user's Canva Team.

display_name.description: The name of the user as shown in the Canva UI.

User.description: Metadata for the user, consisting of the User ID and display name.

display_name.description: The name of the user as shown in the Canva UI.

UserMention.description: Information about the user mentioned in a comment thread or reply. Each user mention is keyed using the user's user ID and team ID separated by a colon (`user_id:team_id`).

tag.description: The mention tag for the user mentioned in the comment thread or reply content. This has the format of the user's user ID and team ID separated by a colon (`user_id:team_id`).
